meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件发送通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送能力
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件通道:复制注册适配器、装依赖、跑构建测试,然后引导配置 Resend 账户、密钥和 webhook,并将你的邮箱设为所有者,发欢迎邮件。之后 NanoClaw 就能用邮件和你异步聊天。
howto.when: 当你要为 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 电子邮件通道,或正在 `/setup` 流程中需要添加邮件功能时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加 Resend 邮件通道
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖、跑测试,并提示你配置凭据

say.text: 用 Resend 接邮件,并把我的邮箱设为所有者
say.note: 会引导你输入邮箱和 agent 文件夹,然后发欢迎邮件

say.text: 帮我设置 Resend 的 API 密钥和 webhook 密钥
say.note: 会把这些凭据写入 .env 文件

howto.what_en: Adds Resend email to NanoClaw: copies and registers the adapter, installs the dependency, runs build and tests, guides you through Resend account, API key, and webhook setup, sets your email as owner, and sends a hello email. Afterward, NanoClaw can chat with you asynchronously via email.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw, or during `/setup` when email integration is needed.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies adapter, installs dep, runs tests, prompts for credentials.

say_en.text: Hook up email via Resend and set my address as owner.
say_en.note: Asks for your email and agent folder, then sends a hello.

say_en.text: Set up the Resend API key and webhook secret.
